notes.title: Playtest v0.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
Completely remade the dialogue and quest system!
 Converted / edited some existing quests
 Added the concept of quest objectives
 Quest tracker added to track current progress on objectives
 Card minigame added!
 Some NPCs now have set decks / difficulties to play cards with and offer rewards

notes.title: v0.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
- Fullscreen setting added to Main Menu
- Quit button added to Main Menu
- 60 Fixed FPS option added to Main Menu
- Random text removed from Character Creation Screen
- Camera Collision remade, now snaps into view when collides
- Character now disappears into FPS mode when camera is too close
- Triggers now implemented to remove fog + water inside boat
- Items no longer fall through the boat floor when dropped (mostly)
- Items that fall down too far will appear at the point they were dropped
